title: Google's AI Exodus: Foundation Developers Launch New Venture #shorts

top_comments.author: @CircuitSage-d5e
top_comments.text: Honestly, four leads out and Wall Street panics over 5%. I'm watching where those builders land. US AI retention is getting shaky, and the UAE is building a real alternative. Smart money reads the room.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: Exactly — when 4 leads leaving tanks the stock 5%, it shows how much the company depends on them. And with the UAE throwing money and compute at builders, US retention isn’t guaranteed anymore. Think the US can pull them back, or is the talent drain already starting?
